value.rationale: The source provides only nonquantitative sufficient small-step behavior for a momentum-type matrix optimizer; exact stability-loss onset and existence of a locally attracting oscillatory competitor for every supercritical step are practically and structurally motivated. The sharp threshold ranges from 2 to 4/3 across momentum values and the explicit cycle amplitude gives the full supercritical branch. Its complete zero-momentum global dichotomy clarifies limits of local conclusions. The finding is self-contained, mathematically nontrivial as a quantified two-dimensional nonlinear recurrence and does not overstate full-matrix or stochastic implications.
